scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Mantis?
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
你已經獵殺了50只螳螂了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
嗯，我覺得你還沒獵殺夠50只。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Remember, I need help hunting Mantis so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
記住，我需要你幫忙獵殺螳螂，所以去獵殺50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
你確定要停止獵殺嗎？
你目前的進度將會被清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
好的，如果你改變主意，隨時回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Please kill 50 Mantis in order to make this a Place were people can go to and gather Experience.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
請獵殺50只螳螂，好讓這裡成為人們可以前往並獲取經驗的地方。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
太棒了，你完成得真快。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Oh great!
You are here to help me right?
If not, i don't know what to do with the Monsters in this Place!
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
太好了！
你是來幫我的吧？
如果不是，我真不知道該怎麼處理這裡的魔物了！

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Great! I knew the moment i saw you that i can count on you!
I need you to reduce the Amount of Monsters which are currently rampaging on this Map!
There are to many Mantis around, which makes it impossible for the lower level players to gain good experience here.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
太好了！我一看到你，就知道可以指望你！
我需要你減少目前在這個地圖上肆虐的魔物數量！
這裡的螳螂太多了，導致低等級的玩家無法在這裡獲得良好的經驗。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
So, would you still like to help me?
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
那麼，你還願意幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Thank you for your great help with the Mantis!
Currently the Situation is stable and i'm not in need of your help anymore to kill them.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
非常感謝你幫我處理螳螂！
目前的情況已經穩定，我不再需要你幫忙獵殺它們了。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Kill 50 of those Mantis and let me know when you're done. I will reward you for your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
獵殺50只螳螂，完成後告訴我。我會獎勵你的付出。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
如果你改變主意，請回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
如果你改變主意，請回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Oh boy, Oh boy!
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
天哪，天哪！

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Sorry I can't talk right now I am in a world of pain here, these darn Mantis are going to kill me.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
抱歉，我現在沒法說話，我快被這些該死的螳螂逼瘋了。
